sources.title: Sidneyia inexpectans
sources.source_type: primary museum collection account, fossil photographs and historical reconstruction
sources.locator: ROM 61118 and USNM 57487 image panels/captions; Marianne Collins 1988 2D reconstruction; Description and Age & Localities
sources.supports: Specimen identity, scale context, overall overlapping-shell/narrow-rear form and head notches.
sources.visual_inspection: Inspected full pixels: Collins reconstruction 2560x2297; ROM 61118 2560x1749; USNM 57487 2560x1284. Fossils are compressed. Right lectotype panel is historically retouched and not treated as independent anatomical evidence.
sources.limitations: Older no-post-antennal-cephalic-limb claim is superseded for this brief by 2023 primary research. Three abdominal rings are a published alternative, not silently combined with the selected two-ring restoration.
sources.rights: ROM and Smithsonian photographs by Jean-Bernard Caron; Collins illustration copyright retained. Private consultation only; no images, mesh, palettes or texture pixels incorporated.

sources.title: Reconstructing the diet of a 505-million-year-old arthropod: Sidneyia inexpectans from the Burgess Shale fauna
sources.authors: Axelle Zacaï, Jean Vannier, Rudy Lerosey-Aubril
sources.source_type: primary anatomical and diet research, author-shared copy
sources.supports: Nine tergites; two-ring restoration; tail fan, low vaulting, gnathobasic feeding and sea-floor diet.
sources.visual_inspection: Actual Figure 1 dorsal/ventral and Figure 2 lateral fossil/drawing pixels inspected, including tail roots and abdominal labels.
sources.limitations: Post-antennal allocation in this paper predates the 2023 revision. Shell volume and posture are interpretations; food contents do not establish a particular attack behavior.
sources.rights: Elsevier copyright; author-shared research consulted privately. No figure redistribution or incorporated external assets.

sources.title: An early Cambrian Sidneyia (Arthropoda) resolves the century-long debate of its head organization
sources.authors: Kunsheng Du, David L. Bruton, Jie Yang, Xiguang Zhang
sources.publication: Science China Earth Sciences 66 (2023), published online 14 February 2023
sources.locator: Emended genus diagnosis; Remarks on USNM 139720; Discussion and conclusions, including USNM 269165
sources.supports: Three head-limb pairs and one biramous pair per thoracic tergite; a distinct ventral hypostome.
sources.visual_inspection: Text consulted, not used as a complete S. inexpectans image blueprint.
sources.limitations: New micro-CT specimens are S. minor. Application to S. inexpectans is the authors’ cross-species anatomical interpretation. Do not import S. minor body size or segment counts.
sources.rights: Science China Press copyright; citation and factual consultation only.

sources.title: New artiopodan euarthropods from the Chengjiang fauna (Cambrian, Stage 3) at Malong, Yunnan, China
sources.authors: Yuyan Zhu, Han Zeng, Yao Liu, Fangchen Zhao
sources.locator: Genus Sidneyia emended diagnosis; Table 3; Sidneyia remarks
sources.supports: Independent adoption of three head-limb pairs; S. inexpectans measurements, nine tergites and explicit two-versus-three abdominal-count disagreement.
sources.visual_inspection: Text and tabulated measurements consulted; figures of other species are not shape references.
sources.limitations: Published dimensions are body measurements of fossils, not measured height, antenna span or a reconstructed living individual.
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0; no figures or text excerpts incorporated.
